data.title: Spišské Tomášovce – a drawing of the hillfort by Vesna
data.excerpt: Spišské Tomášovce can be regarded as the most important Slavic hillfort in eastern Slovakia. In September 2023 the archaeologist Matúš Hudák asked us for a drawing of this hillfort for a forthcoming book on the history of the Spiš region, and our member Vesna took on the task.

timeline.title: A new drawing of the hillfort is made
timeline.description: In September 2023 the archaeologist Matúš Hudák approached the civic association Hradiská with a request for a drawing of the hillfort for a forthcoming book on the history of the Spiš region. The drawing was made by our member Vesna.

mediaTexts.alt: A drawing of the hillfort on a rise, with drawings of a vessel, a mount and a bracelet above it

children.text: can be regarded as the most important Slavic hillfort in eastern Slovakia. In September 2023 the archaeologist Matúš Hudák approached us with a request to supply a drawing of this hillfort for a forthcoming book on the history of the Spiš region. Our member Vesna took on the task with pleasure, and the result is this beautiful new drawing of the hillfort on our website.
